sourceText: The reason we have a review is to look at your care plan with you and make sure the adults are doing what they are supposed to and that your care plan is still right for you.
sourceHTML: The reason we have a review is to look at your care plan with you and make sure the adults are doing what they are supposed to and that your care plan is still right for you.
targetText: Lý do chúng tôi đánh giá là để cùng bạn xem xét kế hoạch chăm sóc của bạn và đảm bảo rằng người lớn đang làm những gì họ phải làm và kế hoạch chăm sóc của bạn vẫn phù hợp với bạn.
targetHTML: Lý do chúng tôi đánh giá là để cùng bạn xem xét kế hoạch chăm sóc của bạn và đảm bảo rằng người lớn đang làm những gì họ phải làm và kế hoạch chăm sóc của bạn vẫn phù hợp với bạn.

sourceText: I want you to be as happy as possible and properly cared for.
sourceHTML: I want you to be as happy as possible and properly cared for.
targetText: Tôi muốn bạn hạnh phúc nhất có thể và được chăm sóc đúng cách.
targetHTML: Tôi muốn bạn hạnh phúc nhất có thể và được chăm sóc đúng cách.

sourceText: It is my job to make sure you are listened to, and your review is your chance to ask the adults what they are doing for you.
sourceHTML: It is my job to make sure you are listened to, and your review is your chance to ask the adults what they are doing for you.

sourceText: Although we may talk about you in the review, we do this to make sure the adults are doing what they should, and we will give the adults tasks to complete to make sure your care plan is still supporting you.
sourceHTML: Although we may talk about you in the review, we do this to make sure the adults are doing what they should, and we will give the adults tasks to complete to make sure your care plan is still supporting you.

sourceText: These tasks will be called review decisions, and these are about jobs for the adults.
sourceHTML: These tasks will be called review decisions, and these are about jobs for the adults.

sourceText: After the review, I will write a report, and you can have a copy, but I will write you a letter.
